reason_for_change: Adds a flying 2/3 Specter whose combat-damage trigger can either return a permanent or force a discard.
commander_identity_rationale: Directly supports Crosis’s combat-damage discard plan while offering an alternative tempo mode against a problematic permanent.
role_impact: Adds an evasive body and flexible trigger; removes a low-cost equipment/equip package.
power_level_impact: Four-mana creature is slower than the equipment, but supplies a body and two modes.
